in_hindi.name: देवनन्द
in_hindi.meaning: देव (Deva) - दान (Dana) - नन्दन (Nandana) - नाद (Nada) - आनन्द (Anand) - नन्दनानन्द (Nandanand)
in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (Deva) - God, दान (Dana) - Gift, नन्दन (Nandana) - Delight, नाद (Nada) - Sound, आनन्द (Anand) - Bliss, नन्दनानन्द (Nandanand) - God of Delight and Bliss

in_marathi.name: Debananda
in_marathi.long_meaning: Debananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Debananda is a Sanskrit name derived from two words - ‘Deba’ meaning God and ‘Ananda’ meaning delight or pleasure. This name symbolizes the immense joy and happiness one experiences when in the presence of God.
